text:
debrief db-021
1) the record notes the actor m-e-r-g-e-d the f-a-k-e breeding logs with the r-e-a-l permit copies, leaving a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p mismatch on the s-c-a-n n-o-t-e-s that no one v-e-r-i-f-i-e-d at intake.
2) the actor r-e-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-d old ownership deeds under new names, a m-o-v-e that was t-r-a-c-e-d via the f-o-n-t m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a in the p-d-f but the i-d-m-e-t-h-o-d c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k was not p-e-r-f-o-r-m-e-d.
3) the actor p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d online listings with s-t-o-r-k-e-d price tags, a t-r-a-c-e that survived in the c-a-c-h-e d-u-m-p but the a-u-t-h-o-r i-p-m-a-t-c-h was not r-u-n against the vendor registry.
4) the actor a-l-t-e-r-e-d the hatch date fields in the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e, a c-h-a-n-g-e l-o-g-g-e-d by the d-b-a-u-d-i-t row that no o-f-f-i-c-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w-e-d before the e-x-p-o-r-t was s-i-g-n-e-d off.
5) the actor u-s-e-d a s-t-o-l-e-n scanner badge to s-t-a-m-p the export forms, a b-a-d-g-e-l-o-g entry that would have f-l-a-g-g-e-d at the shift r-e-p-o-r-t but the d-a-i-l-y spot check was s-k-i-p-p-e-d that week.
